common.language.warning.invalid_variable: `LOCAL_DELEGATE_LANG` is set to "{value}", which is not valid: use `es` or `en`, with or without a region.
common.language.warning.invalid_preferen: The preference file {path} has no valid language and is ignored.
common.language.warning.unreadable_prefe: The preference file {path} could not be read and is ignored.
common.output_language.warning.control_c: `LOCAL_DELEGATE_OUTPUT_LANGUAGE` contains line breaks or control characters and is ignored.
common.output_language.warning.too_long: `LOCAL_DELEGATE_OUTPUT_LANGUAGE` is longer than {max} characters and is ignored.
common.backend_params.warning.unknown_ro: Role "{role}" does not exist, so its key "{key}" is ignored.
common.backend_params.warning.unknown_ke: Key "{key}" of role {role} is not an accepted parameter and is removed.
common.backend_params.warning.reserved_k: Key "{key}" of role {role} is controlled by the product and cannot be configured: it is removed.
common.backend_params.warning.deferred_k: Key "{key}" of role {role} is not supported yet and is removed.
common.backend_params.warning.bad_type: Key "{key}" of role {role} has a value of the wrong type and is removed.
common.backend_params.warning.out_of_ran: Key "{key}" of role {role} has an out-of-range value and is removed.
common.backend_params.warning.malformed_: An entry of `LOCAL_DELEGATE_BACKEND_PARAMS` is malformed (role "{role}", key "{key}") and is ignored: the format is `role.key=value`.
common.backend_params.warning.duplicate_: Key "{key}" of role {role} is repeated in `LOCAL_DELEGATE_BACKEND_PARAMS`: the last one wins.
common.backend_params.warning.override_t: `LOCAL_DELEGATE_BACKEND_PARAMS` is longer than 2048 characters and is ignored entirely.
common.backend_params.warning.thinking_w: Role {role} turns reasoning on without `reasoning_budget_tokens`: `enable_thinking` is ignored.
common.backend_params.warning.file_unrea: `backend-params.json` could not be read or is not valid JSON: it is ignored entirely.
common.backend_params.warning.file_bad_v: `backend-params.json` does not have `version: 1` and is ignored entirely.
common.backend_params.warning.file_too_l: `backend-params.json` is larger than 64 KB and is ignored entirely.
common.backend_params.warning.context_es: The context size of the model for role {role} could not be read from the llama-swap config: an estimate of 8192 tokens is used.
common.backend_params.warning.context_ov: In role {role}, reasoning does not fit in the model context: the call goes without reasoning.
